Please don't share card details in this chat. We can't accept card numbers here, and I'd recommend treating that card number as compromised and checking with your bank.

About NW2001: it failed delivery on 7 Nov and is being held at the local depot. Under our policy, you can book one free redelivery after a failed attempt. Each further redelivery costs 4.90 EUR. I can't see from your account whether the free redelivery has already been used on this parcel. The parcel is held for 5 business days after the failed attempt, so please book the redelivery before that hold ends (around 13 Nov).

I can't advise on how to pay the 4.90 EUR fee here. Please use the payment options shown when you book the redelivery.
